header: Notification bell with unread count badge
Private & Secure — your data is encrypted and never shared
add-expense-cta: Receipts can be attached — snap a photo or upload a file
category-breakdown: Legend displayed below chart with color swatch, category name, and amount
recent-transactions: Each row shows merchant icon, description, category badge, date, red amount, and edit/delete action icons
View All Transactions link routes to /transactions
filters-and-sort: Category — All Categories / Housing / Food & Drink / Transport / Groceries / Software / Travel / Healthcare / Other
Date Range — pick a start and end date to scope your view to any custom period
Sort by — Newest first / Oldest first / Highest amount / Lowest amount
Search — type a merchant name or keyword to filter results instantly
Reset Filters — clear all active filters and return to the full transaction list

summary-stats.label: Total Spent This Month
summary-stats.description: Sum of all expenses logged in the current calendar month

summary-stats.label: Total Transactions
summary-stats.description: Count of individual expense entries recorded this month

summary-stats.label: Largest Single Expense
summary-stats.description: The highest-value transaction logged this month

summary-stats.label: Average Transaction Value
summary-stats.description: Total monthly spend divided by transaction count

transactions-table: Date — formatted as MMM DD, YYYY, sortable ascending or descending
Description — merchant name or short note entered when the expense was logged
Category — color-coded badge indicating the expense type
Amount — expense value in your default currency, displayed in red
Actions — inline Edit and Delete buttons per row
Row hover state — subtle indigo-tinted background highlight
Empty state — No transactions found. Try adjusting your filters or log your first expense.
pagination: Previous — navigate to the prior page of results
Page numbers — direct jump links showing up to 5 page numbers
Next — navigate to the following page of results
Rows per page — selector to display 10, 15, 25, or 50 transactions per page
Result count label — Showing 1–15 of 47 transactions
form-header: Editing an existing expense? All fields are pre-filled — just update what changed and hit Save.
Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*). Receipt upload is optional but recommended for accurate records.

expense-form.label: Amount *
expense-form.hint: Enter the exact amount spent (e.g. 42.50). Supports up to two decimal places in your selected currency.

expense-form.label: Category *
expense-form.hint: Choose from Housing, Food & Drink, Transport, Groceries, Software, Travel, Health, or Entertainment.

expense-form.label: Date *
expense-form.hint: Pick the date the expense occurred. Defaults to today.

expense-form.label: Description
expense-form.hint: Add a short note about this expense. Appears in your Transactions list and search results.

expense-form.label: Receipt
expense-form.hint: Upload a photo or PDF of your receipt (JPG, PNG, or PDF up to 5 MB).

expense-form.label: Currency
expense-form.hint: Inherits your default currency from Settings. Override per-transaction if needed.

actions: Save Expense — Confirms and stores the transaction to your account.
Cancel — Discards all changes and returns you to the previous page without saving.
Save & Add Another — Saves this expense and clears the form so you can log the next transaction.
Delete Expense — Available in edit mode only. Permanently removes this transaction after a confirmation prompt.
